blocks.text: Thai embassies in Greece and Italy have advised Thai residents and tourists to exercise caution, avoid protest areas and closely follow local developments amid demonstrations in both countries. The Royal Thai Embassy in Athens said on Monday (October 19) that Greek media had reported plans by student groups to hold demonstrations against the government at Syntagma Square in central Athens on October 20 and 21. The protesters are calling for increased funding for educational institutions and greater assistance with students’ study and living costs.
